title: Grammar: order of adjectives (table, A)

paras.en: Use the following table to practice using the proper order of adjectives in the following sentences.
paras.ur: درج ذیل جملوں میں صفات کی درست ترتیب استعمال کرنے کی مشق کے لیے درج ذیل جدول استعمال کریں۔
paras.ps: په لاندې جملو کې د صفتونو د سم ترتیب د کارولو د تمرین لپاره لاندې جدول وکاروئ.

paras.en: A. Tell which of the sentences are in the usual correct order of adjective.
paras.ur: الف. بتائیں کہ ان میں سے کون سے جملے صفات کی معمول کی درست ترتیب میں ہیں۔
paras.ps: الف. ووایئ چې له دې جملو څخه کومې د صفتونو په معمولي سمه ترتیب کې دي.

sourceNote: Printed page 143. The page begins with the sentence "Use the following table to practice…" (the first words are clipped at the left edge) and a table with the columns Number, Opinion, Size, Age, Shape, Color, Origin, Material, Purpose and Noun; its cells hold: small / round / Pakistan; red / sleeping; generous / old / man; four / metal (the row positions follow the print). Part A lists twelve items, each with two or three variants of the same sentence, so the order of adjectives can be compared. The Urdu and Pashto of each variant are translations of the meaning; the variants are marked (A), (B), (C) by us. Border lines, a pink corner flag, the watermark and the phone-number strip are excluded. The page number 143 is printed in a diamond at the foot.
